about: build.clang_patches rule `no-large-offset-merge`: AArch64's load/store optimizer without its fifth step,
tryToMergeIndexLdSt (llvm/lib/Target/AArch64/AArch64LoadStoreOptimizer.cpp, LLVM 18 and later), which turns a
constant offset built in a register and a register-offset load or store (`mov w9, #lo; movk w9, #hi, lsl #16;
ldr w0, [x8, x9]`) into an add of the offset's high part and an immediate-offset access (`add x8, x8, #hi,
lsl #12; ldr w0, [x8, #lo]`). A toolchain built without that step keeps the register-offset form. No option
turns the step off (aarch64-load-store-const-scan-limit only shortens its search), so the rule is a byte
patch: the step's merge starts by asking hasUnscaledLdStOffset whether the access has an unscaled offset and
gives up when it has; each edit makes it give up whatever the answer. zkit applies a patch to a copy of the
official binary whose SHA-256 is the patch's `sha256`, checks each edit's `old` bytes first and the result
against `patched_sha256` (build.patched_clang). Offsets are file offsets; each `why` names the instruction
(virtual address) it changes; a macOS copy's ad hoc code signature gets the changed pages' hashes
after the edits (build.refresh_code_signature), so its `patched_sha256` is of the copy with them.

patches.release: LLVM 22.1.8 for Linux x86-64, LLVM-22.1.8-Linux-X64.tar.xz: bin/clang-22 (bin/clang and bin/clang++ link to it)
patches.function: (anonymous namespace)::AArch64LoadStoreOpt::optimizeBlock at 0x73c24c0, which has the fifth step's loop and tryToMergeIndexLdSt inlined: the loop reads the opcode's scale (0x73c319c-0x73c31df), calls AArch64InstrInfo::hasUnscaledLdStOffset at 0x73c31eb, and goes on to findMatchingConstOffsetBackward (the read of aarch64-load-store-const-scan-limit at 0x73c322d) only when it says no

edits.why: 0x73c31f2 je 0x73c321c -> 2-byte nop: the merge always gives up as for an unscaled offset, and the loop steps to the next instruction (0x73c31f4)

patches.function: AArch64LoadStoreOpt::optimizeBlock's fifth-step loop with tryToMergeIndexLdSt inlined (no symbols; found from the aarch64-load-store-const-scan-limit option, whose value at 0x1467af968 only it reads, at 0x140d8e4eb): the loop reads the opcode (0x140d8e408) and its scale, calls AArch64InstrInfo::hasUnscaledLdStOffset at 0x140d8e4d0, gives up at 0x140d8e53f (the step to the next instruction) when it says yes

edits.why: 0x140d8e4d7 jne 0x140d8e53f -> jmp 0x140d8e53f: the merge always gives up as for an unscaled offset, and the loop steps to the next instruction

patches.release: LLVM 22.1.8 for macOS Arm64, LLVM-22.1.8-macOS-ARM64.tar.xz: bin/clang-22 (bin/clang and bin/clang++ link to it)
patches.function: (anonymous namespace)::AArch64LoadStoreOpt::optimizeBlock at 0x1011812e4, which has the fifth step's loop and tryToMergeIndexLdSt inlined: it calls AArch64InstrInfo::hasUnscaledLdStOffset at 0x101187468, reads aarch64-load-store-const-scan-limit (LdStConstLimit+0x78) at 0x10118748c, and gives up at 0x101185e58 (the step to the next instruction)
